verdict.line: You win the fight when Riven's Valor (E) is down and you catch her with your stun, but you lose the lane over time once she starts stacking Q resets and threatens Wind Slash after level 6.

brief.thesis: Riven can only block or gap-close with E (Valor), which sits on a 10/9/8/7/6s cooldown; while it's down she has no answer to Irelia's Q (Bladesurge) dash into E (Flawless Duet) stun-and-mark, which is why Irelia holds a real lane and solo-kill edge in raw trades. That edge doesn't hold up over 544 games (43% win rate) because Riven's Q (Broken Wings) resets and her post-6 Wind Slash punish Irelia for extending fights or walking away at partial HP, clawing the advantage back as the lane goes on.

theirWindow.when: Q, W, and E all off cooldown
theirWindow.what: She can chain Broken Wings strikes into a point-blank Ki Burst stun and empowered Runic Blade autos with no gaps in her kit. Back off and let her burn a cooldown on a fake approach instead of trading into a fully-loaded Riven.

yourWindow.what: Dash in with Q (Bladesurge) and immediately follow with E (Flawless Duet) to stun and mark her. She has no block and no gap-close to escape the follow-up, so this is when you commit hardest.

powerCurve.note: R grants range, Wind Slash execute
wall zoning vs. Wind Slash range

start.why: The dominant start on this matchup (43.3% win rate, 89.3% pick over 566 games) — extra AD and sustain let you hold trades long enough to stack Ionian Fervor before Riven can burst you down.

boots.why: 87.3% pick and the higher-winrate choice (41.9% over 528 games); flat physical reduction blunts Riven's Runic Blade-empowered autos and repeated Broken Wings pokes.

core.why: Highest-winrate opening core (46.2% over 106 games); % max-health on-hit punishes Riven's flat HP pool and the active slow helps you stick through her Q dashes.
Scales single-target duel damage and tankiness for the extended trades this matchup forces once you can't just one-shot her.
Converts burst into a heal-back-over-time, which is exactly what you need against her Q-into-Ki Burst all-in combo.

situational.when: riven is healing back through your trades and you need magic damage plus tenacity to shrug off her Ki Burst stun chains
you want faster wave clear and burst over Hullbreaker's split-push pressure
riven is snowballing kills off her Blade of the Exile all-ins and you need insurance against a burst combo

runes.keystoneWhy: Ramps damage and healing across an extended trade, letting you match or outlast a Riven who is doing the same thing — per OP.GG's own read, this is a stack-race matchup and Conqueror is how you win it rather than just trading once and backing off.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the most-picked combo (66.6% pick, 42.4% win rate) and matches the aggressive, solo-kill-favored shape of this matchup off your E stun and Q reset. Exhaust+Flash has the higher measured win rate (45.1% over 28.8% pick) and is the safer pick if you'd rather neutralize her Q-Q-Q all-in and post-6 Wind Slash than race for an early kill.

playing.title: Bait Ki Burst before committing
playing.detail: Ki Burst stuns everything near Riven on an 11/10/9/8/7s cooldown. Hover just outside 260 range and let her waste it on a false step before you walk in with Q.

playing.title: Engage when Valor is down
playing.detail: Once her E (Valor, 10/9/8/7/6s cooldown) is spent, she has no block or gap-close left — dash in with Q and follow with E to stun and mark her while she can't answer.

playing.title: Chain E's mark into a second Q
playing.detail: Flawless Duet marks anything caught between its two blades. Land it, then immediately Bladesurge onto the marked target to refresh Q's cooldown for a second dash-strike in the same trade.

playing.title: Respect Wind Slash post-6
playing.detail: Once Riven hits R, she gains bonus AD, bonus range, and a one-time ranged Wind Slash. Don't walk away from a trade at low HP or she can finish you from outside melee range.

playing.title: Only charge W when she's locked down
playing.detail: Defiant Dance's damage scales with charge time but leaves you exposed mid-channel. Start charging only after your E has stunned her or she's already burned Broken Wings to disengage.

playing.title: Track her Conqueror stacks
playing.detail: OP.GG's own read on this matchup is to watch her Conqueror stacking during extended fights — once she's capped, her healing and damage spike, so cut the trade short instead of matching her stack-for-stack.

playing.title: Don't chase her Q charges
playing.detail: Broken Wings can be reactivated up to three times, with the third hit knocking back anything nearby. If she's already used one or two charges running from you, expect a knockback, not a free kill.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, and every win-rate or pick-rate figure here come directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the ability interactions, timing windows, and trade patterns are my own tactical reading laid over that data.

stats.opponentTip: Engage while keeping an eye out on Riven’s Conqueror stacks. Engage when Riven’s skills are on cooldown by using [P] to your advantage.
